## Summary

Describe the change and the learner problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Technical/content correction
- [ ] New or strengthened exercise
- [ ] Test improvement
- [ ] Documentation or community maintenance

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. If exercise tests changed, explain how you checked them against a temporary reference implementation.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the explanation, solved example, and homework distinct.
- [ ] I expanded acronyms on first use in each changed document.
- [ ] Tests collect without network access or external services.
- [ ] I updated tests and documentation together when changing an exercise contract.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, personal data, proprietary material, or confidential interview questions.
- [ ] I read and agree to follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
